gps_time_pi/data/messier.json

Contains data from OpenNGC by Mattia Verga (https://github.com/mattiaverga/OpenNGC),
licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License
(CC BY-SA 4.0): https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
Full legal code: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/legalcode

Source: database_files/NGC.csv and database_files/addendum.csv at OpenNGC commit
be3cd6c54988 (2026-10-18).

Changes made by GPS Time (tools/build_sky_data.py):
- only the 110 Messier objects are kept;
- right ascension and declination are converted to decimal degrees and rounded to 0.0001 deg;
- OpenNGC's object-type codes are written out as words;
- the magnitude is OpenNGC's V magnitude, else its B magnitude, else none;
- "Common names" are split into a list;
- M102, which OpenNGC lists as a duplicate of M101, takes M101's data with a note saying so.

This file (messier.json) is therefore an adapted work of OpenNGC and is itself licensed
under CC BY-SA 4.0, not under the MIT License that covers the rest of GPS Time. Anyone
redistributing a changed version must keep this attribution and license it the same way.
